title: CRL: Dynamics 365 for a new subsidiary | enCloud9
meta: How enCloud9 implemented Dynamics 365 for CRL's newly acquired subsidiary in three months, migrating years of data and rebuilding essential workflows.
answer: Clinical Reference Lab (CRL), a laboratory testing provider in Lenexa, KS, bought Confirm BioSciences in 2020. The subsidiary used a CRM initially designed for smaller businesses. We implemented Dynamics 365, migrated several years of historical data into Dynamics 365 Sales and rebuilt essential workflows. In three months CRL gained better visibility across its sales pipeline.
facts: CRM initially designed for smaller businesses
outcomes: The initial implementation was completed in three months.
Visibility across the sales pipeline improved.
CRL Government Services expressed strong interest in expanding its relationship with enCloud9.
chapters: In 2020, Clinical Reference Laboratory (CRL), a leading provider of laboratory testing services headquartered in Lenexa, Kansas, purchased Confirm BioSciences, a company specializing in health screening solutions. The acquisition was a step toward expanding CRL's reach into government services and corporate wellness programs, and CRL wanted to streamline and strengthen the new subsidiary's operations.

Confirm Bio, now operating as CRL Government Services, was using a CRM system initially designed for smaller businesses. It lacked scalability, integration capabilities and sophisticated reporting. CRL had already partnered with enCloud9 on other CRM initiatives.

An experienced enCloud9 consultant led the project, working closely with CRL's Director of Sales. We implemented Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement with a focus on streamlining sales and customer service processes.
We migrated several years of historical data into Dynamics 365 Sales and rebuilt essential workflows.
The team has better visibility across its sales pipeline and stronger customer engagement, laying the groundwork for future innovation.
next_steps: CRL Government Services expressed strong interest in expanding its relationship with enCloud9 to integrate additional Dynamics 365 applications and optimize other business functions.
author: Kristin Caniglia
